key_points: BAC stock down ~3% on Sep 22 and ~8% last week after CEO remarks, showing near‑term selling pressure.
Media highlights AI‑driven disruption (Meta's Muse agent) threatening traditional wealth‑management and brokerage businesses.
Sector rotation away from financials noted in market commentary, adding short‑term headwinds.
BofA’s own research notes on China AI adoption and oil‑price warnings provide mixed macro outlook but no direct earnings impact.
No material earnings, guidance, or M&A news; effect likely limited to sentiment‑driven price moves.
